policy.rule: A visible function is not considered confirmed merely because the control exists. It needs behavioral automation or an explicit manual device check.
policy.newControlGate: Every new visible control must appear in this inventory before release.
policy.changedControlGate: Changed controls should gain targeted behavioral coverage in the same release when practical.
policy.manualPolicy: Platform-specific behavior that cannot be automated is marked manual/not-performed, never inferred from Chromium.
